name: Black Bear
description: The first bear you will ever encounter in your journey, he stands nearby the Starter Shop.

quests.name: The Legend of the Silver Hive

name: Brown Bear
description: Brown Bear is the second ever bear you will encounter, he is located right at the start of the 5 Bee Zone, his quests are more focused on gathering tokens and using abilities, making his quests more time consuming.

name: Polar Bear
description: Polar Bear is located at the 15 Bee Zone near the Blue Shop, he tasks the player with collecting a bunch of pollen. He is the first bear to give a Diamond Egg as a reward.

name: Painter Bear
description: Painter Bear is an artistic bear who asks you to collect Sticker Tokens making him the most time consuming bear to complete.

name: Panda Bear
description: Panda Bear tasks the player with defeating various mobs across the world.

name: Sandy Bear
description: Sandy Bear is a laid-back bear found near the beach, offering quests centered around the coastal fields.

name: Sun Bear
description: Sun Bear basks in the golden light of the Lemon Field, challenging players with increasingly demanding quests centered around honey tokens and tropical crafting.

name: Botanist Bear
description: Botanist Bear, also known as Delilah, tends to her special flowers in the Greenhouse. Unlike other bears, she does not have a fixed quest line, instead she offers an endless cycle of 10 rotating quests that repeat forever once completed.

name: Druid Bear
description: Druid Bear watches over the Wheel, tasking players with deepening their bond to the Wisteria, Lotus, and Blossom Fields.
